literal_meaning: চোখকে গরম করা (to make the eyes hot)
figurative_meaning_en: To make the eyes red or bloodshot
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুঃখে তার চোখ গরম হয়ে গেল।
ক্রোধে সে চোখ গরম করে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: In sorrow, his eyes became hot (reddened).
In anger, he made his eyes hot (bloodshot).
note: This idiom often implies emotional intensity leading to reddened eyes, common in everyday Bengali expression.
